title: Cask preflight: migrate casks out of unwritable appdirs
intent: Repair ChatGPT.app emptied by a failed brew bundle cask upgrade, and stop future upgrades from emptying any app cask recorded in an appdir the non-admin user cannot write, by reinstalling such casks into ~/Applications before activation.
proof_hooks: Stubbed-brew harness: outdated and gutted casks in a read-only appdir are reinstalled into ~/Applications; fresh and writable casks untouched; failed reinstall restores the Caskroom record and exits 1; read loop is not consumed by brew install
Real repair: ChatGPT 26.924.22138 installed in ~/Applications with codesign --deep --strict passing
stop_conditions: Reinstall would require admin rights or delete an app in /Applications
